It's a long journey... Don't Stop...

Video

Every time I turn around this President is finding a new way to grift off the American people.

Video

Everyone knows Congressman Clyburn is a leader who has stood up not just for his district, but for his entire state - and the ridiculous criticism of him  sounds  like coded bigotry to me.

Video

Incredible wisdom from an incredible woman.

Video

Instead of fighting to save hardworking American families money — here’s what Donald Trump is focused on: putting himself on money.

He’s not thinking about your wallet. He’s thinking about what else he can stick his  name on. 

op:@aaronparnas

Video

An update on my fight to make youth sports more affordable: Spring sports are underway, but too many kids are stuck on the sidelines—not because they lack talent or desire, but because their families simply can’t afford it.

Video

You are not better off than you were two years ago. Trump’s reckless war, chaotic tariffs  and cruelty are crushing American families—skyrocketing gas prices, higher healthcare costs, and everyday essentials out of reach. This economic pain echoes the crises of the 1970s, but it’s happening on his watch after he promised lower costs and no more wars.

Video

Voting rights are under attack — again. The rights of the many are being undermined by the powerful few. 

This isn’t a threat to the freedoms of some; it’s a threat to the freedoms of all.

Trump’s midterm partisan gerrymandering has unleashed a whirlwind, sweeping away the foundations of fair democracy. 

His Supreme Court has gutted basic voter protections and the principle of equal representation.

Randolph’s words remind us that democracy is unfinished work. 

As long as any citizen is shut

I am here right now because people joined hands, through sacrifice and struggle, to advance our democracy.

The very principle of fair elections has been eviscerated by the Supreme Court.

Video

Trump cares more about himself, his family riches, and his ballroom than the struggles working families are facing because of his policies.

Video

I have little trust Trump can negotiate anything positive for our nation with China, and I'm worried that he will continue to sell out the American people as we struggle at home and our foreign policy interests are compromised abroad.

Video

In states like Alabama and Tennessee, Trump and his cronies are rigging congressional maps to silence minority voters. This is a direct assault on our democracy, echoing the grave injustices of Plessy v. Ferguson and Korematsu.

This fight isn’t about party—it’s about right versus wrong. We must reject partisan gerrymandering, demand fair maps, and secure equal representation for every American.

Video

This is not a time to step back, it is a time to step up more, help more, jump into action and extend yourself for others. 

Our nation is full of humble heroes. Let's add to their number.

Video

We need more of this.

More hands reaching out. More quiet acts of solidarity. More people believing in each other’s potential instead of tearing each other down.

Video

Donald Trump is a disaster.

He does not care about the economic pain he is causing Americans.
Now

Video

This should make you angry. The Trump administration's cruel ICE detention of his desperate parents delayed their final goodbye and robbed this family of precious time. This heartless cruelty is not who we are as Americans. 

op: @aaronparnas

Video

The Supreme Court may have issued a decision. It’s time for us to again make history.
